title: Waystones issue #1126: Natural Waystone activation invalid.

text:
[issue by von-get]
### Minecraft Version

1.21.11

### Mod Loader

Fabric

### Describe the Issue

When activating a new waystone found in a village (haven't found wild ones yet), it will 'successfully' activate it with the name 'invalid'. Right-clicking it again does not bring up the teleport menu, but instead just 'successfully' activates again.

I didn't have this issue before upgrading to 21.11.5, and downgrading it to 21.11.4 seems to have resolved it.

Additionally, picking up the waystone and putting it back down does seem to allow normal interaction.

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
I've tried in singleplayer, on a server, and with a waystone generated on 21.11.4 but activated on 21.11.5, and all of them activated fine. I am unable to reproduce this issue with just the mod installed by itself. 

Please provide a step-by-step guide on how to make the problem appear with a minimal set of mods.

[comment by Sxtanna (none)]
I have also encountered this issue... but on 1.21.1

I cannot tell you exactly what causes this, but an easy way to fix this would be to just guard activation and/or do a best effort for handling invalid waystones.

Currently the activation process completely ignores whether the waystone passed into it is invalid or not. 
Everything is a happy path, the actual `activateWaystone` is just void, and the activation handler can only return `InteractionResult.SUCCESS`.

I have verified that the data for the waystone exists in `waystones.dat` in the world folder with the following data:
```
{
	"NameV2": "",
	"Origin": "VILLAGE",
	"Transient": false,
	"Type": "waystones:waystone",
	"Visibility": "ACTIVATION",
	"World": "minecraft:overworld",
	"BlockPos" {X Y Z},
	"WaystoneUid": {I I I I}
}
```

I believe you could simply go to this line:
https://github.com/TwelveIterations/Waystones/blob/37b0751fab6e79e9af0b045d261d584e8d865d12/common/src/main/java/net/blay09/mods/waystones/block/WaystoneBlockBase.java#L215

And insert:
```java
if (waystone instanceof InvalidWaystone) {
	// fail the interaction
	// OR
	// attempt to initialize the waystone from the store
}
```

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
Okay, it looks like the issue only happens when trying to activate the top half of the waystone.

[comment by von-get (none)]
I can confirm that the update fixed my issue, thank you very much!
